title: fix(core): cancel pending emitChange on silent setDocument
body:
## Motivation / 背景与动机
 
- Issue: none filed for this specific bug — found while reading `performSetDocument` / `scheduleChange` in `packages/core/src/editor.ts`, not from an existing issue or roadmap entry.
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): n/a
- OpenSpec change: n/a — per CONTRIBUTING.md §"Skip proposal for: Bug fixes...", this is a bug fix and doesn't require an OpenSpec proposal.
没有对应的已存在issue，是在读`editor.ts`里`performSetDocument`/`scheduleChange`的实现时发现的，不是从已有issue或roadmap条目来的。按CONTRIBUTING.md里"bug fix跳过OpenSpec proposal"的规则，这个改动不需要附OpenSpec。
 
## Changes / 变更内容
 
- `packages/core`: `performSetDocument` now clears any pending `parseTimer` (and queued composition markdown) before applying a document replacement, so a debounced `emitChange` scheduled by a prior edit can no longer fire after a `setDocument({ silent: true })` load with stale, pre-replacement markdown.
- `packages/core/test`: added a regression test (`editor.test.ts`) covering exactly this race — edit pending in debounce → silent `setDocument` before debounce fires → asserts no stale `onChange` call leaks through.
## Testing / 测试
 
- [x] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿 — full monorepo run: 318 tests passed (28 test files), no regressions.
- [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) / 受影响包构建通过 — `pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-core build` succeeds (ESM + d.ts).
- [x] New / updated vitest cases / 新增或更新的 vitest 用例：`packages/core/test/editor.test.ts` → "cancels a pending debounced onChange when setDocument silently loads a new file before it fires". Verified it fails without the fix (reverted the source change locally, confirmed the test catches the exact stale-markdown/fresh-AST mismatch) and passes with it.
- [ ] Manual UI check in electron-demo / electron-demo 手动验证 — not done; this is a timing/state-consistency fix at the `nexus-core` API boundary, not yet exercised through the Electron demo UI.
## Checklist / 自检清单
 
- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits / 标题遵循 Conventional Commits
- [x] Public API changes update package README / types — n/a, no public API surface changed (internal timer-cancellation only).
- [x] Touched `live-preview-table.ts` → n/a, not touched.
- [x] New capability / breaking change → OpenSpec proposal linked — n/a, bug fix, exempt per CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [x] No secrets / personal vault data committed / 无敏感信息被提交 — confirmed, diff is limited to `packages/core/src/editor.ts` and `packages/core/test/editor.test.ts`.
